theme: A drowned archipelago where volcanic glass grows out of the tide like coral. Storm-priests read the weather in its facets, reef-clans harvest it for blades, and something older is waking under the deepest shelf. Flavour is coastal, weathered and elemental: salt, obsidian, kelp, thunderheads, and creatures shaped by pressure and current.

mechanics.name: Skywake
mechanics.description: Storm-riders and glass-winged scouts hold the air; white and blue press the advantage while the board stalls.

mechanics.name: Glasscut
mechanics.description: Obsidian weaponry: small bodies that trade up, and burn that finishes what the blades start.

mechanics.name: Rootbound
mechanics.description: Kelp-forest giants that grow into the late game; green and white build the biggest body and swing.

mechanics.name: Undertow
mechanics.description: The deep shelf pulls things down: blue and black grind the opponent's library and refill their own hand.

archetypeNotes: WU wants cheap evasive bodies and ways to keep the ground stalled.
BR wants efficient trades: deathtouch and first strike blockers plus reach damage.
GW wants a curve topping out at genuinely large creatures with trample.
UB wants card flow and a mill clock as an alternate finish.
RG wants aggressive bodies with haste and pump rather than card advantage.
